rationale: The papers 2203.04890, s2:A High Time Resolution All-Sky Monitor for Fast Radio Bursts and Technosignature, 2012.08348, and 2410.13561 provide new insights into the variability and detection of FRBs, contributing evidence relevant to the characterization of short-term and low-level variability in this field.
